##### Project general facts

Port de La Mer by Meraas offers a refined island-inspired lifestyle with breathtaking views of the open sea and Dubai skyline. Designed with a Mediterranean architectural concept, the development blends timeless elegance with contemporary interiors, creating a unique coastal retreat within the city. The project features a curated selection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to maximize space, light, and panoramic waterfront vistas.

Residents enjoy a wide range of premium amenities set within beautifully landscaped surroundings, including swimming pools, private beach access, marina promenades, and a vibrant waterfront lifestyle. The community is enriched with a 190+ berth marina and yacht club, seaside walkways, retail outlets, cafés, and restaurants, along with 5-star hospitality experiences that elevate everyday living.

The apartments feature modern interiors with flowing layouts, high-quality finishes, and attention to detail, creating a bright and elegant living environment. Kitchens are fully equipped with appliances, while the overall design emphasizes comfort, functionality, and contemporary style. The apartments are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah is one of Dubai's most coveted residential neighborhoods, celebrated for its luxurious beachfront lifestyle, breathtaking villas, and vibrant community atmosphere, where residents can indulge in the perfect blend of modern convenience and serene coastal living. The area is characterized by its picturesque tree-lined streets, lush parks, and effortless access to the pristine Jumeirah Beach, creating a unique and captivating environment that effortlessly blends natural beauty with the sophistication of urban living. Jumeirah's unique charm is further enhanced by its stunning natural surroundings and the array of leisure activities available to residents.

The neighborhood boasts an impressive array of world-class amenities, including top-rated schools, premium shopping destinations, and an exceptional selection of fine-dining restaurants, all of which contribute to the area's distinctive charm and character. The iconic Jumeirah Beach Road is lined with an eclectic mix of boutique stores, cozy cafés, and wellness centers, expertly catering to the diverse needs and preferences of Jumeirah's discerning residents, while cultural landmarks like the majestic Jumeirah Mosque and the nearby La Mer waterfront add a touch of history and cultural significance to the area. The presence of these amenities and landmarks creates a rich tapestry of experiences, offering residents a unique and captivating lifestyle.

For those who appreciate outdoor activities, Jumeirah provides a diverse range of opportunities for fitness and recreation, including beachfront jogging tracks, scenic cycling paths, and water sports facilities, all of which take full advantage of the area's stunning natural beauty and picturesque scenery. The community is also exceptionally well-connected to the rest of Dubai, with easy access to major highways and key business districts, ensuring that residents can effortlessly balance their professional and personal lives, while the area's tranquil ambiance and private streets maintain a sense of peaceful seclusion, making Jumeirah one of the most desirable and exclusive places to live in Dubai.
